features.name: Fighting Style
features.description: You gain a Fighting Style feat of your choice.

features.name: Second Wind
features.description: Bonus Action: regain 1d10 + Fighter level Hit Points.

features.name: Weapon Mastery
features.description: Use the mastery property of a number of weapon kinds you have proficiency with.

features.name: Action Surge
features.description: On your turn, take one additional action except the Magic action.

features.name: Tactical Mind
features.description: When you fail an ability check you can expend a use of Second Wind to add 1d10 to the roll; if the check still fails, the use is not expended.

effects.reason: reacts to a failed check after the roll, spending another feature's use: needs a roll-reaction pipeline

features.name: Fighter Subclass
features.description: You gain a Fighter subclass of your choice.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Gain a feat (Ability Score Improvement or another general feat).

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: You attack twice when you take the Attack action.

features.name: Tactical Shift
features.description: Whenever you activate Second Wind you can move up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

effects.reason: movement rider on another feature's activation

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: Intelligence is your spellcasting ability; you keep a spellbook and prepare spells from it.

features.name: Ritual Adept
features.description: You can cast Wizard spells with the Ritual tag from your spellbook without preparing them.

features.name: Arcane Recovery
features.description: After a Short Rest (once until a Long Rest), recover expended spell slots with combined level up to half your Wizard level (rounded up), none of level 6+.

effects.reason: restores slots by a combined-level budget chosen at rest time: a rest-flow action with a knapsack choice

features.name: Scholar
features.description: Expertise in one chosen skill of Arcana, History, Investigation, Medicine, Nature, Religion in which you have proficiency.

features.name: Wizard Subclass
features.description: You gain a Wizard subclass of your choice.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Gain a feat (Ability Score Improvement or another general feat).

features.name: Memorize Spell
features.description: After a Short Rest you can replace one prepared spell with another from your spellbook.

effects.reason: rest-time rewrite of the prepared list
